props.text: Cancún's nonstop fits neatly into a standard federal-worker PTO pattern — quick out, quick back. Aspen has a genuinely documented D.C.-specific pull beyond tourism: the Aspen Institute runs its Security Forum in Aspen every summer, then a "D.C. Edition" of the same event in Washington each winter, creating real, verifiable traffic between the two cities among the policy crowd. Oaxaca draws modest, deliberate interest from D.C.'s foreign-service community despite the connection.
